sections.heading: 1. Who we are and what this policy covers

blocks.text: Kyro Learning is an independent educational initiative operated by Ashay Kumar, based in India ("Kyro Learning", "we", "our" or "us"). We provide information and educational resources for parents, teachers, counsellors, students and other interested visitors through kyrolearning.com (the "Website"). This Privacy Policy explains how personal data is handled when you visit the Website, send feedback using "Share Your Perspective", request the "Home Leadership Kit", or contact us.
The operator is responsible for determining the purposes of the personal data processing described in this policy. Questions, privacy complaints and requests may be sent to info@kyrolearning.com.
We collect only information relevant to the service or interaction involved. Depending on how you use the Website, this may include:

Home Leadership Kit requests: name, email address, phone number and any other fields actually displayed on the request form; adult confirmation; necessary acknowledgement of the privacy notice; optional follow-up and marketing choices.
Share Your Perspective: feedback, answers to questions and any optional contact details you choose to provide, together with form acknowledgements and choices.

Submission and audit information: submission or retry identifier, date and time, the versions of notices or consent wording presented, and submission outcome information required to process requests and prevent duplicates.
Communications: information you send us by email or in response to a permitted follow-up.

Technical and security information: IP address, browser/request information, approximate device information, error or security events, and authentication or bot-prevention signals that may be processed by our hosting and security providers.

We do not intentionally request government identification numbers, payment card details, medical records or information about a child through these forms. Please do not include such information in free-text fields.
We use the information for the purpose shown when it is collected, including to:
Receive, organize, review and respond to education-related feedback.
Process Home Leadership Kit requests and provide the download after the backend confirms the submission is stored.
Provide a response or follow-up where requested, chosen or otherwise permitted by applicable law.

Send optional updates or marketing communications only where a separate, valid permission has been provided and such communications are enabled; submitting a form does not automatically subscribe you.
Keep the Website working, protect against abuse and fraud, troubleshoot errors, maintain relevant records and avoid duplicate processing.
Comply with applicable legal obligations and handle valid rights, complaints or lawful requests.

Where processing relies on your consent, the request for consent will specify the relevant purpose. You may refuse optional purposes without losing access to a resource that does not require them. We will not use contact information collected for one stated purpose for an unrelated purpose without an appropriate legal basis and notice.

The educational material on this Website may be read by people of different ages. Our submission forms, however, are intended for adults aged 18 or older. Parents and lawful guardians may request resources for a child using the adult’s own contact information. We ask that you do not include a child’s name, contact details, date of birth, health information or other identifying or sensitive details in the forms or feedback fields.

We do not knowingly use our forms to collect personal data directly from children or engage in targeted advertising directed at children. If you believe a child has submitted personal information, contact us so we can review and take appropriate action. If Kyro Learning later adds child accounts or direct child submission features, we will first introduce the necessary age-appropriate notices, safeguards and parent/guardian consent processes under applicable law.

Submitted form information is transmitted through our website backend and stored in restricted-access Google Sheets. Cloudflare supports website hosting and delivery, backend execution, access control, security and bot prevention. These services may process request information such as IP addresses and browser details to deliver and protect the Website. Authorized helpers supporting the operation of Kyro Learning may access information only as needed for the specified purposes.

These providers may process data in countries other than India, subject to applicable legal requirements and the providers’ service terms and safeguards. We may also disclose information where required by applicable law, a valid legal process, or to protect the Website and its users. We do not sell personal data. We do not disclose form submissions publicly or use attributed testimonials without appropriate permission.

Kyro Learning follows a manual review and deletion process for personal data submitted through its website forms. Submission records are stored in restricted-access Google Sheets and reviewed monthly to assess whether they remain necessary for their original purpose.

We retain personal data only while it is reasonably necessary for the purpose explained at collection. Records that are no longer required are deleted or anonymised, subject to applicable legal, operational or dispute-related retention requirements. Confirmed test submissions are removed after verification.

Individuals may request access-related assistance, correction or deletion of their information by contacting info@kyrolearning.com. Requests are reviewed, with reasonable identity verification where necessary, and handled in accordance with applicable law.
Kyro Learning does not currently operate an automatic deletion schedule. Its manual review procedure will be updated as operational needs and applicable legal requirements evolve.
Consent withdrawal will stop processing for the withdrawn optional purpose, subject to lawful exceptions; it will not automatically erase processing already completed.

sections.heading: 7. Your choices, rights and how to make requests

blocks.text: You may contact info@kyrolearning.com to request information about how your data is handled, correction or updating of inaccurate data, deletion where applicable, withdrawal of optional permission, or assistance with a privacy concern. Please indicate which form or communication the request relates to. We may ask for reasonable verification before disclosing or changing personal data.

We will assess and respond to requests in accordance with the Indian laws applicable at the time of the request. Where the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and its relevant provisions are in force, additional statutory rights and grievance remedies will apply as provided by that law. We do not require you to agree to optional marketing in order to make a privacy request.

We use technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect website submissions and personal data, including restricted access to submission storage, server-side handling of sensitive credentials, protected API routing, input validation, abuse protection and transport encryption. Access permissions are limited to people who need them for the operation of the service.

No online system is guaranteed to be completely secure. If we become aware of a data incident, we will investigate, take reasonable containment measures and provide legally required notifications where applicable. Please avoid sharing sensitive information in open text fields.

The Website uses necessary technologies for security and essential operations. Cloudflare may provide aggregate traffic and performance measurements, such as page views and load times, to help us understand how the Website is used. Where enabled, Cloudflare Web Analytics measures visits and page performance without analytics cookies. We do not send form submissions or contact details to Web Analytics. Cloudflare Access may set reviewer login cookies during private review. With your permission, Google Analytics 4 measures visits to public pages and arrivals associated with the approved Meta campaign so we can understand how people find and use the Website. Google may process analytics cookie identifiers, browser and device information, and network information such as your IP address during transmission. We send approved page locations and campaign labels and exclude form answers and contact details. Advertising personalisation is disabled. You can withdraw permission through the Cookie Policy. External services have their own privacy practices.

We may revise this Privacy Policy as the Website, its data uses and the law change. The published version will show its effective date. Where a change requires a new notice or consent, we will provide it before the relevant new processing begins.
Privacy contact: Kyro Learning, operated by Ashay Kumar, India Email: info@kyrolearning.com Website: https://kyrolearning.com

sections.heading: 1. What cookies and similar technologies are

blocks.text: Cookies are small pieces of information that a website or its providers store in or retrieve from your browser. Similar technologies include local storage, session storage and security tokens. Some are necessary to deliver or protect a service.

sections.heading: 2. How Kyro Learning currently uses these technologies

blocks.text: Kyro Learning uses necessary technologies for essential operations. These technologies may support the following.
Website operation, secure routing, delivery and troubleshooting.
Protection against unwanted automated submissions and other abuse, including form verification with Cloudflare Turnstile.

Maintaining authentication sessions for authorized reviewers while Cloudflare Access protects the private Website. These review-only cookies may cease to be relevant once the Website is publicly available.
Maintaining necessary security or form workflow state.
Hosting and security storage varies by environment and by which Cloudflare features are active.
Strictly necessary cookies and similar technologies support operation, security, authentication where applicable and abuse prevention. Blocking them in your browser may impair some functions.
Cloudflare may provide aggregate traffic and performance measurements. Where enabled, Cloudflare Web Analytics measures page visits and performance without analytics cookies.

Optional Google Analytics uses first-party analytics cookies to recognise visits when you turn on website analytics. It measures public page visits and can receive the approved Meta campaign labels on an eligible landing page. We exclude other URL parameters, click identifiers, fragments, full referrers, and form information from the page views we send. Kyro Learning does not use advertising cookies.

Use the checkbox below to turn Google Analytics on or off. Analytics is off until you opt in. Your choice is stored in this browser for up to 180 days. Choices saved by the previous analytics system do not apply. Turning analytics off stops future collection and clears accessible analytics cookies. It does not delete information already sent to Google. The Website, feedback form and kit remain available either way.

You can block or delete cookies and clear other site data using your browser settings. Browser restrictions may affect protected reviewer login or security checks. Cloudflare and Google explain how they process data in their privacy policies at https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/ and https://policies.google.com/privacy.
We may update this policy when technologies change. For questions about the Website’s use of cookies, email info@kyrolearning.com.

sections.heading: 4. Home Leadership Kit and other free resources

blocks.text: Unless the resource itself specifies a different license, Kyro Learning grants a personal, non-exclusive, revocable, non-transferable permission to download and use its free resources for non-commercial learning and educational purposes. Parents and guardians may use them at home. Teachers and counsellors may use them in their own teaching or guidance activities and may distribute unmodified copies directly to the students or families they work with, with Kyro Learning attribution retained.

Without prior written permission, you must not sell a resource, include it in a paid resource bundle, remove copyright or ownership notices, present it as your own creation, publicly rehost downloadable files, publish altered versions as Kyro Learning materials, or broadly redistribute it outside your own educational setting. Reasonable accessibility adjustments for a learner’s personal use are permitted if they do not misrepresent the resource or remove attribution. Contact info@kyrolearning.com for wider licensing or collaboration requests.

Our submission forms are for people aged 18 or older. Parents or lawful guardians may submit requests on behalf of children using the adult’s own contact details. You agree to submit accurate information, use only details you are entitled to provide, and avoid sharing children’s identifying information or other sensitive information in open feedback fields.

If you submit feedback, you give Kyro Learning permission to receive, store, review and use its substance internally to understand or improve our educational material and services, in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Your submission does not authorize us to identify you publicly, publish an attributed testimonial, or reproduce your private correspondence for promotion without appropriate additional permission. You retain any rights you hold in your original submission.

You must not use the Website to violate the law or another person’s rights; impersonate others; submit misleading, abusive, defamatory or unlawful content; upload malware; attempt unauthorized access; interfere with security systems; scrape or overload the service abusively; or misuse its forms, resources or protected review environment. We may restrict access or remove inappropriate submissions where reasonably necessary, subject to applicable law.

The Website may link to or depend on third-party services, including hosting, security or file storage providers. Those services may have their own terms and privacy practices. Kyro Learning does not endorse or assume responsibility for third-party content merely because it is linked on the Website.

We aim to keep the Website useful and accurate, but educational content may be updated, incomplete or unsuitable for a particular learner or setting. We may modify, suspend or discontinue Website features or resources and may correct errors without prior notice where permitted by law. We do not promise uninterrupted operation or perpetual availability of any downloadable resource.

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, the Website and its free informational resources are provided on an "as available" basis without warranties beyond those that cannot legally be excluded. Kyro Learning is not responsible for losses that arise solely from using general educational information as a substitute for individualized qualified advice or from circumstances beyond its reasonable control.

Nothing in these Terms limits or excludes liability for fraud, wilful misconduct, violations of applicable law or any rights and remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded, including applicable consumer rights. Any limitation is subject to those protections.

Personal data submitted through the Website is handled under our Privacy Policy. We may revise these Terms by posting an updated version with a new effective date. Your subsequent use may be subject to the updated Terms to the extent legally permissible; we will seek any additional consent the law requires.

These Terms are governed by the laws of India, subject to any mandatory rights, protections and forum rules that apply to users. Disputes will be handled by courts or other competent bodies having jurisdiction under applicable law.
